title: 1990 Bowman #117 Larry Walker Montreal Expos Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 1990 Bowman #117 Larry Walker rookie card featuring the Montreal Expos. This baseball trading card is from the Major League Baseball (MLB) and is part of the 1990 Bowman set. The card is a standard size and is manufactured by Bowman in the United States. It is not autographed and is considered a valuable collectible for fans and collectors of sports trading cards.
